class.name: StaticLayer
class.description: Reads a static OccupancyGrid map from a topic and writes it into the master costmap.

class.name: ObstacleLayer
class.description: Marks and clears obstacles from laser/pointcloud sensor data.

class.name: VoxelLayer
class.description: Populates a 3D voxel grid from laser/pointcloud data and projects it into the 2D costmap.

class.name: InflationLayer
class.description: Inflates obstacle costs outward by a configurable radius.

class.name: LegacyInflationLayer
class.description: Inflates obstacle costs outward using the legacy BFS-based algorithm.

class.name: RangeSensorLayer
class.description: Populates the costmap from IR/Sonar range sensors using a probabilistic model.

class.name: PluginContainerLayer
class.description: Holds a list of plugins and applies them only to this layer.

class.name: DenoiseLayer
class.description: Filters noise-induced standalone obstacles or small obstacle groups.

class.name: KeepoutFilter
class.description: Applies a binary keepout mask from an OccupancyGrid onto the costmap.

class.name: SpeedFilter
class.description: Limits robot speed based on a speed-restriction mask.

class.name: BinaryFilter
class.description: Flips a binary state published as std_msgs/Bool based on a binary mask.
